description:
Repeats its input shape on a grid.
This node does not support overlapping between instances.

inputs.description: The input shape, defined as a signed distance function
inputs.name: in

name: Repeat

outputs.description: The shape generated by the repeat operation
outputs.label: Output

parameters.description: The number of columns in the grid
parameters.label: X
parameters.name: rx

parameters.description: The number of lines in the grid
parameters.label: Y
parameters.name: ry

parameters.description: The amount of random rotation on each instance of the input shape
parameters.label: R
parameters.name: r

parameters.description: Check to repeat variations of the input
parameters.label: Variations
parameters.name: variations
